data.description: Practice building fractions using visual circle models with denominators from 2 to 10.

judgement.reasoning: The student added both numerators and denominators (2/5 + 1/5 = 3/10). The generated activity just asks the student to shade single fractions (1/2, 1/3, 2/4, 1/5, 3/10) isolated on circle models. It never combines fractions or demonstrates that adding fifths keeps pieces as fifths, completely missing the target obstacle of denominator addition.
judgement.verdict: No teacher would use this detour because it only practices building isolated unit/simple fractions and does not address why adding fifths leaves the denominator unchanged.
